groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are 9th Judicial District judges (serving Fremont with Sublette and Teton). Full names follow official court pages already used in the Sublette and Teton histories. Official 2026 Fremont clerk abstract named-retention YES/NO totals are recorded for Jason M. Conder, Erin E. Weisman, and Jefferson Boone Coombs.
